title: Memoryless Nonlinearity
text: Apply amplifier models to complex baseband signal, 1 input, 1 output, {Type of Non-linearity} sets Type of nonlinearity; {Model} sets the amplifier, {Linear power gain (dB)}, {IIP3 (dBm)} sets the input third-order, {OIP3 (dBm)} sets the output, {IP1dB (dBm)} sets the input, {OP1dB (dBm)} sets the output, {IPsat (dBm)} sets the input saturation, {OPsat (dBm)} sets the output, {Lookup table (Pin(dBm), Pout(dBm), deg)} sets the lookup table -10, 20, -2; {Output saturation level (V)}, {Magnitude smoothness factor}, {Phase gain (rad)}, {Phase saturation}, {Phase smoothness factor}, {Input scaling (dB)} sets the scaling factor for input signal level, {AM / AM parameters [alpha beta]} sets the aM/AM conversion parameters, {AM / PM parameters [alpha beta]} sets the aM/PM conversion parameters, {Output scaling (dB)} sets the scaling factor for output signal level, {Reference load (ohm)}, {Plot power characteristics} and {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run. Values come from the instance.
